text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—What a fine display of running! The 
Junior Class Make Debut, everyone has now 
crossed the finish line!
(Waaaaah--!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha, ahahahaha☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Racing is totally Marvelous☆ Running 
together is Marve-looous★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you all felt it too, didn't you!? 
That you're amazing! That you're 
marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? M-Me?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, sorry! I just kind of don't really 
get 'marvelous,' you know?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Me too. It was just my debut, and I didn't 
even win, right? I guess maybe it doesn't 
feel amazing at all...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that's not true at all! Everyone is 
super Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Because you remember, don't you? The day 
you decided to enter Tracen Academy!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
How hard I worked toward my Make Debut! 
The cheering voices of everyone who 
supported me, and the things I kept 
telling myself, too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"If even one of those had been missing, 
you wouldn't be here at today's Make a 
Debut☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You decided, you sought it, and you worked 
hard for it— that's why you're here right 
now!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That's super amazing☆ So—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Congrats ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Standing at the starting line of the 
Twinkle Series, we're all totally 
Marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I see... That's so true!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Being able to debut is an amazing thing 
after all! I need to give myself a proper 
pat on the back...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That's it!! You did great!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to everything you'll 
accomplish in the future, too!

After Marvelous Sunday finished running 
his debut race in brilliant fashion, I 
went out to greet him—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm back! I just finished my Make Debut 
run☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Listen, it was just like I thought! So 
thrilling, so heart-pounding☆ So happy, so 
much fun★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: It was soooooooo marvelous☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Harder, stronger! The harder I kick up 
the turf!! The louder everyone's cheers 
become☆★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Run more, run faster— show me something 
even more incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer! I wanna spread even more 
marvelousness☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
To as many people as possible, as fast as 
possible☆ So please, tell me!★ What should 
I do from here on out?
choice_data_list:
First, let's build up our strength 
properly!

text_block_list.text:
Just seeing her run today made me realize 
it all over again: the wall of the Twinkle 
Series is formidable indeed.

Aiming for high-profile races right off 
the bat might seem quick, but if you can't 
deliver results, your dream of spreading 
"Marvelous" won't come true either.

That's why our goal for the Junior Class 
should be to focus on training, while also 
entering a few races to get used to the 
environment.
choice_data_list: And steadily grow your fan base!

text_block_list.text:
As long as our goal is to spread the 
"Marvelous," it should also be meaningful 
to keep our fan count in mind to some 
degree.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hrmmmmmm, which means—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Marvelous World Domination Plan", Step 
One! ☆ Train a whole bunch and get a 
marvelous, super-strong run!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Wait, that's what it means, right!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, we gotta hurry back 
to the academy! If I run with all my 
might, I wonder if I can get back faster 
than the train☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe use the ride for strength 
training and do an air squat the entire 
way?!
choice_data_list:
No training today! I'm just heading home 
like normal!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Booo! That's totally not marvelous! I 
wanna run so much more!"

Marvelous Sunday is full of energy even 
right after the race. This positivity will 
surely become a powerful weapon for her 
going forward.

Develop her strengths and steadily grow 
her fan base. I made up my mind to support 
her through the Junior Class with that 
approach—
